## Featured Projects

### 1. IntentGuard — AI Agent Payment Security & Intent Verification
- **Description:** A proactive security layer for autonomous AI agents that verifies user-authorized payment intent before transactions are processed.
- **Stack:** Python, FastAPI, Ed25519, SHA-256, React, Mock UPI Sandbox
- **Key Capabilities:**
  - Cryptographic verification of payment limits, expiry, and authorized payees using Ed25519 signatures.
  - Two-tier firewall with rule-based validation, prompt injection detection, and lookalike merchant identification.
  - Tamper-evident SHA-256 hash-chained audit trail.
  - Mock UPI sandbox demonstrating real-time transaction approval, injection blocking, and emergency revocation.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/gensine/intentguard

### 2. FreelanceX — Decentralized Freelance Marketplace
- **Description:** A decentralized freelance marketplace on Base Sepolia featuring smart contract-based USDC escrow, wallet authentication, and multisignature dispute resolution.
- **Stack:** React Native, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Solidity, Foundry, Viem, SIWE, Base Sepolia
- **Key Capabilities:**
  - Smart contract escrow managing freelance milestone payouts.
  - 2-of-3 multisignature arbitration for transparent dispute resolution.
  - Sign-In with Ethereum (SIWE) for decentralized wallet authentication.
  - Monorepo architecture with automated Foundry smart contract tests.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/jaiswalism/FreelanceX

### 3. Unified API Gateway & Health Monitor — Real-Time Microservice Monitoring
- **Description:** Full-stack monitoring dashboard to track microservice health, uptime, latency percentiles, and service availability in real time.
- **Stack:** Python, FastAPI, React, Vite, SQLAlchemy, SQLite, APScheduler, WebSockets, Axios, Recharts
- **Key Capabilities:**
  - Service registry with configurable health endpoints and monitoring intervals.
  - Automated background polling and WebSocket-based push updates without page reloads.
  - Latency analytics and degradation identification with an extensible alerting pipeline.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/gensine

### 4. MerchantAI Catalog Agent — Autonomous Agentic Commerce
- **Description:** AI-native infrastructure layer built for Razorpay AI Buildathon 2026 that normalizes merchant catalogs into vector embeddings under 10ms with ACP/AP2 protocol APIs.
- **Stack:** Python 3.13, FastAPI, AI Agents, Razorpay SDK, Vector Store / RAG, ACP/AP2 Protocols, Pydantic, Pytest
- **Key Capabilities:**
  - Multi-format catalog ingestion (CSV, PDF, web scraping) into vector embeddings.
  - ACP/AP2 protocol-aligned endpoints for machine-readable discovery by AI buyers.
  - Autonomous AI Buyer loop with tool calling for semantic product search and stock gating.
  - Strict money-action guardrails: spend limit caps, price integrity, idempotency, and Razorpay test checkout.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/gensine/MerchantAI-Catalog-Agent

### 5. Emoti-Sense AI — Multilingual Emotion Engine
- **Description:** End-to-end ML pipeline for real-time facial micro-expression analysis and speech/text sentiment classification.
- **Stack:** Python, Scikit-learn, Computer Vision, React, Git

### 6. Credit Card Fraud Detection Engine
- **Description:** Financial anomaly classification on highly skewed transactional datasets using SMOTE and Random Forest with precision, recall, and ROC-AUC benchmarking.
- **Stack:** Python, Scikit-learn, SMOTE, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib

### 7. Elyxir — Relational Pharmacy Management Platform
- **Description:** Normalized MySQL database architecture with 8+ relational tables modeling inventory, suppliers, batches, and transactions.
- **Stack:** Next.js, MySQL, Relational Joins, Window Functions

### 8. xBridge — Single-Transaction Cross-Chain Swap
- **Description:** Cross-chain liquidity bridge executing token swap and bridge routing via LiFi API on Sepolia testnet.
- **Stack:** Sepolia, LiFi API, React.js, Node.js, Web3.js
